title: Cell: The Building Block of Life

concepts.learning_objective: State the limit of resolution of the human eye and why microscopes are needed to study cells.
Calculate total magnification and compare light and electron microscopes.
Estimate the real size of a cell from the field of view of a microscope.

topics.title: Cell Membrane: The Universal Feature of a Cell

concepts.learning_objective: Explain that the cell membrane is selectively permeable.
Distinguish diffusion from osmosis and explain osmosis in cells.
Predict the effect of isotonic, hypotonic and hypertonic solutions on a cell.
Describe the composition and fluid-mosaic structure of the cell membrane.

topics.title: Cell Wall: The Outer Covering of Cells

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the composition, permeability and functions of the cell wall.
Compare how plant and animal cells respond to a concentrated solution.

topics.title: The Cell Interior: Prokaryotic and Eukaryotic Cells

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells by nucleus, organelles and size.
Describe the cytoskeleton and cell inclusions in the cytoplasm.

topics.title: Nucleus, Ribosomes, ER, Golgi Apparatus and Lysosomes

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the nucleus, chromatin, chromosomes, DNA and genes.
Explain the roles of ribosomes and of rough and smooth endoplasmic reticulum.
Describe how the Golgi apparatus packages materials and lysosomes clean up the cell.
Describe the structure of mitochondria and their role in releasing energy as ATP.
Distinguish chloroplasts, chromoplasts and leucoplasts by pigment and function.
Explain how the central vacuole stores materials and keeps plant cells firm.

topics.title: How Cells Grow and Divide: Mitosis and Meiosis

concepts.learning_objective: Explain that mitosis forms two genetically identical cells for growth and repair.
Explain that meiosis forms four gametes with half the chromosome number.
Interpret the observation of dividing cells in an onion root tip.

topics.title: Cell Theory and the Life Span of Cells

concepts.learning_objective: State the classical cell theory and the scientists who formulated it.
Explain contact inhibition and how its loss leads to tumours.
Explain the role of programmed cell death in development.
